description: This file defines classes related to workflow entity management within the vtiger CRM system, including entity retrieval, caching, and database interactions.

classes.name: VTWorkflowEntity
classes.description: Represents a workflow entity, providing methods to access and modify entity data, retrieve module name, and determine if the entity is new.

classes.name: VTEntityCache
classes.description: Provides a caching mechanism for VTWorkflowEntity objects, allowing retrieval by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a VTWorkflowEntity object, retrieving data from the server and decoding HTML entities.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the entity data as an array.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Determines and returns the name of the module associated with the entity.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets the value of a specified field in the entity data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified field in the entity data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Updates the entity data via an external API call.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks whether the entity is new by examining whether the old entity exists.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a specific user and prepares an internal cache array.

methods.name: forId
methods.description: Retrieves a VTWorkflowEntity object from cache or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.
